title: Zoe products
description: A centred semibold heading over a 2×2 grid of big warm-cream product cards (24px radius, flat): a product shot across the top with an optional small white price badge, a large light-weight name, a short description and a yellow button, then an italic footnote. One column with full-width buttons on phones.
notes: cards are the card colour; product shots sit on it without a frame
